name: Rim Light Button
description: A button whose border carries a soft arc of light that circles it and floods the whole border on hover.

props.name: children
props.description: The label, with an optional icon. Icons are sized to 16 pixels.

props.name: as
props.description: Element to render, for example "a" for a link. Props for that element are passed through.

props.name: duration
props.description: Seconds for the light to go once round.

props.name: color
props.description: Colour of the light and of the faint tint inside on hover.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the inner surface that holds the label: padding, background, text.

props.name: containerClassName
props.description: Classes for the outer element, which is the button itself: radius, height, width. Any radius works; the default is a pill.
